currentState: On-call incident response is ad hoc: alerts page whoever is awake via a shared Slack channel, there are no written runbooks, and postmortems happen inconsistently (roughly 1 in 4 incidents gets one) with no tracked follow-up actions.
desiredState: A mature incident response process: alerts route through a formal on-call rotation with escalation policies, every recurring incident type has a written runbook, every SEV1/SEV2 incident gets a blameless postmortem within 5 business days, and postmortem action items are tracked to closure.

gaps.current: Alerts post to a shared Slack channel with no defined owner or escalation path
gaps.desired: Formal on-call rotation with tiered escalation policies and paging SLAs
gaps.gap: No ownership model or escalation tooling exists today
gaps.action: Adopt a paging tool (e.g., PagerDuty or Opsgenie) and define a rotation with 2 escalation tiers within one quarter

gaps.current: Zero written runbooks; tribal knowledge lives in senior engineers' heads
gaps.desired: Every recurring incident type (top 10 by frequency) has a written, tested runbook
gaps.gap: 10 runbooks need to be authored and validated against real incidents
gaps.action: Mine the last 6 months of incidents for the top 10 recurring types and assign one runbook per engineer per sprint

gaps.current: Only ~25% of incidents get a postmortem, and none have tracked follow-up actions
gaps.desired: 100% of SEV1/SEV2 incidents get a blameless postmortem within 5 business days, with action items tracked to closure
gaps.gap: No enforced postmortem trigger and no action-item tracking system
gaps.action: Make postmortems a mandatory exit criterion for closing a SEV1/SEV2 incident ticket, and track action items in the existing issue tracker with a due date

actionPlan: Quarter 1: stand up the paging tool and on-call rotation with 2 escalation tiers
Quarter 1-2: author and validate the top 10 runbooks, one per engineer per sprint
Quarter 1: make postmortems mandatory for SEV1/SEV2 closure and start tracking action items in the issue tracker
Quarter 2: audit postmortem completion rate and action-item closure rate; target 100% and 90% respectively
